picks.file: Burgos celebris et antiqua Hispaniaecivitas quae Auea, Braumm, Masburgi, Licontinitiurgis, nomina habet ; Sanct. Sebastianum vulgo Donostien ad mare Oceanum insigne regni Guipuzcoa oppidum - btv1b53178868h (1 of 2).jpg
picks.what: Engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 1
picks.why: colored single-sheet copy (no book gutter); castle hill and cathedral spires recognizable; trimmed to the Burgos view, San Sebastián view below cut away

picks.file: Theatrum hispaniae exhibens regni urbes villas ac viridaria magis illustria... Material gráfico 119.jpg
picks.what: General view, etching in Pieter van den Berge’s Theatrum Hispaniae (National Library of Spain)
picks.why: general view with castle and cathedral; margins and caption trimmed

picks.what: The cathedral and the Arch of Santa María, steel engraving in Meyer’s Universum
picks.why: cathedral spires and the Arco de Santa María, the city’s signature scene; caption trimmed

picks.what: The Plaza Mayor with the cathedral behind, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: color; arcaded square with the cathedral spires rising behind; high resolution

picks.file: Gezicht op Burgos Lucie van Dam van Isselt.jpg
picks.what: View of the city with the cathedral towers, pencil and watercolor
picks.why: dated sketch (13 August 1935) from the castle hill, cathedral towers at right; modest and only 1000 px wide

picks.file: Burgos city view facing south east.jpg
picks.why: cathedral above the old town’s red roofs; sharp and colorful

notes: #2 is the BnF copy of the 1572 plate (Commons date 1645 is that edition); its faint sheet fold is not a book gutter, unlike #1 and #3. #6 (Wyngaerde drawing, 1565) is only a black-and-white detail around the Casa del Cordón. #15 (J. Laurent, view from the castle) is a strong general view but its date is unclear (Commons 1860; Laurent’s Burgos views are 1860s–1880s), so the color photochrom was preferred for P4. The 1921 La Esfera panorama (#18, #20) has the magazine gutter running through the cathedral, so P5 uses the 1935 sketch; drop it if too weak.
